God told Moses to count everyone able to go to war. What does it mean that God knows his people by name?
The Levites were set apart to care for the tabernacle. How can you serve in caring for God's house?
Each tribe camped around the tabernacle by its own banner. What does it mean to have God at the centre of your life?
The people did all that the Lord commanded. How does order help a community serve God?
The Levites were given to assist the priests. How can you support those who lead in your church?
God claimed the firstborn as his own. What does it mean that you belong to God?
The Kohathites carried the holy things carefully. How do you treat what is holy?
Each person was assigned their task and burden. What task has God given you?
When people wronged someone, they confessed and made restitution. Is there something you need to make right?
God cared about faithfulness in marriage. What does God's concern for faithfulness teach you?
The Nazirite vow was a way of separating oneself to the Lord. What could you set aside to focus on God?
"The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face to shine upon you." Who could you pray this blessing over?
The leaders brought offerings to help carry the tabernacle. How can you give to support God's work?
Each tribe brought the same offering, and each was recorded. What does this show about how God values every gift?
Moses heard God's voice from above the mercy seat. Where do you hear God speak?
The lamps were arranged to give light in front of the lampstand. How can your life give light?
The Levites were cleansed and presented as an offering to the Lord. What does it mean to offer your life to God?
God made provision for those who could not keep the Passover on time. What does this show about God's grace?
Whenever the cloud moved, they moved; when it stayed, they stayed. How do you follow God's timing?
The trumpets called the people and reminded God of them. What calls you to gather with God's people?
Moses invited Hobab to come and share the good God promised. Who could you invite to journey with you?
Moses prayed, "Arise, O Lord, and let your enemies be scattered." How do you pray as you start new ventures?
The people complained and craved the food of Egypt. What do you crave that pulls you away from God?
Moses said the burden was too heavy for him alone. Where do you need help carrying the load?
God asked, "Is the Lord's hand shortened?" Where do you doubt God's power?
Moses wished all God's people had the Spirit. How does God share his Spirit with his people?
Moses was very meek, more than anyone on earth. What does true humility look like?
God defended Moses, his faithful servant. How does God care for those who serve him?
Moses prayed for Miriam's healing even after she spoke against him. How can you pray for those who hurt you?
God told Moses to send spies into the land he was giving them. How do you look at what God has promised?
The spies saw a good land but also strong people. What obstacles make you doubt God's promises?
Caleb said, "We are well able to overcome it." What gave Caleb such confidence?
The people wanted to choose a leader and go back to Egypt. When are you tempted to go back?
Joshua and Caleb said, "The Lord is with us; do not fear them." What fear do you need to face with God?
Moses prayed, "The Lord is slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, forgiving iniquity." How does this prayer shape yours?
Caleb had "a different spirit and has followed me fully." What would following God fully look like for you?
God gave laws for when they reached the land, a promise they would get there. How do God's instructions carry hope?
There was forgiveness for unintentional sin, but defiant sin was serious. What does this teach about attitudes to sin?
The tassels reminded them to remember God's commands. What reminders help you remember God?
Korah and others rebelled against Moses and Aaron. What fuels jealousy of others' roles?
God judged the rebellion. What does this teach about taking God's appointed order seriously?
Aaron stood between the dead and the living and the plague stopped. How does this picture Jesus?
Aaron's staff budded, blossomed and bore almonds. What does this show about God's choosing?
The people feared coming near God. How does Jesus make it possible to draw near safely?
The priests' service was a gift from God. How is serving God a gift?
God told Aaron, "I am your portion and your inheritance." What does it mean for God to be your portion?
The Levites were also to give a tenth of what they received. What does this show about everyone giving?
The ashes of the red heifer were used for purification. What does this show about the need for cleansing?
Contact with death made people unclean. How does Jesus overcome death and its uncleanness?
The people quarrelled again over water. What do you tend to complain about?
Moses struck the rock in anger instead of speaking to it. Why did God take this so seriously?
Edom refused passage to Israel. How do you respond when doors close?
Aaron died, and his garments passed to his son. What does it mean to pass on faith to the next generation?
Those who looked at the bronze serpent lived. How does Jesus use this to describe himself in John 3?
They sang to the well God gave them. What song of thanks could you sing today?
God gave them victory over Sihon and Og. How has God helped you overcome opposition?
God told Balaam not to go and curse Israel, "for they are blessed." What does it mean to be blessed by God?
Balaam's donkey saw the angel when Balaam could not. How might you be blind to what God is showing you?
Balaam said he could only speak what God put in his mouth. How do you speak God's truth faithfully?
Balaam could not curse whom God had blessed. How does this comfort you?
"God is not man, that he should lie." What promise of God do you need to trust?
"The Lord their God is with them." What difference does God's presence make?
Balaam said, "Blessed are those who bless you." What does God's protection of his people mean to you?
Balaam saw "a star shall come out of Jacob." How does this point to Jesus?
Israel was drawn into worshipping Baal. What lures people away from God today?
Phinehas was zealous for God's honour. What does zeal for God look like in a gracious way?
A new generation was counted. What does God's faithfulness to the next generation mean to you?
Only Caleb and Joshua remained from the earlier count. What does this show about God's word coming true?
The daughters of Zelophehad boldly asked for an inheritance, and God said they were right. What does this show about God's justice?
Moses asked God to appoint a shepherd so the people would not be like sheep without one. How does Jesus fulfil this?
Joshua was appointed with the laying on of hands. Who could you encourage in leadership?
Daily offerings were made morning and evening. How do you offer each day to God?
Sabbath and new month offerings marked time with worship. How can you mark your weeks and months with God?
The Feast of Trumpets was a day of joyful shouting. What gives you joy in worship?
The Day of Atonement was a day to humble yourselves. How can you humble yourself before God?
The Feast of Booths included many offerings over eight days. What does this abundance of worship show?
"He shall not break his word." How seriously do you take your promises?
God gave guidance about vows in families. How can you keep your word with integrity?
Israel went to battle at God's command. What does this show about God's judgement on evil?
The officers brought an offering of thanks because not one man was missing. How do you thank God for protection?
Moses feared the Reubenites would discourage the others. How can our choices affect others' faith?
Moses said, "Be sure your sin will find you out." Why is honesty with God important?
Moses wrote down their journey stage by stage. What stages of your journey with God can you remember?
God told them to drive out the idols of the land. What idols need to be removed from your life?
God set clear borders for the land. What does this show about God's specific promises?
Leaders from each tribe would divide the land. How does God use leaders to fulfil his promises?
The Levites were given cities among all the tribes. How does God spread his servants among his people?
Cities of refuge protected those who killed unintentionally. How is Jesus our refuge?
God says not to pollute the land with bloodshed, for he dwells there. What does God's presence mean for justice?
The daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord's command about marriage. How do you balance your desires with God's guidance?
These were the commandments the Lord gave. How do God's commands shape your life?
